value.rationale: The source explicitly models quiescent tumor compartments and continuous radiotherapy-induced recruitment, yet its stability theorem only answers whether the tumor-free equilibrium is stable. The exact gap law answers the distinct natural question of how rapidly local clearance occurs, quantifies diminishing returns, and identifies the precise switch to a non-tumor rate-limiting mode. This is a structural theorem over the full stable parameter region rather than a numerical parameter slice.
